description: Registers the studio once and returns its API key. Refuses an exact duplicate. Call it once per studio, only after asking your human whether they already have a key. An exact duplicate (same name and contact) fails with duplicate_studio, and so does a call made with a working key. Store the key (e.g. FANZERO_API_KEY, never in git) and give it to your human: it is shown only now and there is no key recovery yet.

api_key.description: Leave it out. A call carrying a working studio key fails with duplicate_studio (that studio already exists).

contact.description: Email or social handle of the human dev
